description: This file defines the EmployeeLanguageDao class, which provides data access methods for managing employee language records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and listing employee language data, utilizing Doctrine ORM for database interactions.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for EmployeeLanguage entities, providing CRUD operations and complex queries related to employee languages in the system.

methods.name: saveEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Persists a new or updated EmployeeLanguage entity to the database and returns the entity.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeLanguage entity based on employee number, language ID, and fluency ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeLanguageRecordsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing language and fluency records for a given employee, matching a list of entries.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Deletes employee language records based on provided language and fluency IDs for a specific employee.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Returns a list of EmployeeLanguage entities matching the provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguagesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of EmployeeLanguage records matching the search filter.

methods.name: getAllowedEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Fetches a list of Language entities that the employee is allowed to select or view based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getAllowedEmployeeLanguagesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of allowed languages for an employee based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguagesPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginated query for employee languages with sorting and filtering applied.

methods.name: getAllowedEmployeeLanguagesPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginated query for allowed employee languages, considering fluency count restrictions.
